messages:
Anya M: Quick heads up — I'm at the airport, flight delayed 6+ hrs. I also just got paged: inference-runtime-prod latency spike. I need to hand off primary for tonight 02:00-08:00 UTC. Anyone free to swap? :plane: :wave:

PagerBot: INCIDENT TRIGGERED: PAGER — inference-runtime-prod high token latency. Incident: INC-20231125-42. Pager has been assigned to Anya M (primary).

Sam R: @Anya M I can take primary from 02:00 to 05:00 UTC but have a meeting at ~04:30 — can extend if needed. Taking initial lead. :+1:

Mike L: I can do 04:30-08:00 and shadow 02:00-04:30. I'll join the incident bridge. @Sam R does that work?

Anya M: Perfect — Sam primary 02-04:30, Mike takes over 04:30-08. I'll update rotation and leave the incident on the bridge to you. Runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/space/ONCALL/pages/Inference+Runtime+Runbook

Oncall Bot: Runbook snippet for latency spike:
```bash
# quick mitigation
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime-prod
# route traffic to fallback model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/internal/reroute -d '{"route":"fallback","service":"inference-runtime-prod"}'
```
See full runbook above. Use `--reason` when restarting.

Lisa C: Note: There's a coverage gap 04:10-04:35 UTC where both of you have meeting overlaps. Can we tighten handoff to 04:25? Sam can you push your meeting back?

Sam R: I can slide meeting to 04:40 — okay to extend Mike's shadow by 15 mins. I'll move handoff to 04:25 so overlap is 35m. @Mike L ok?

Mike L: Works. I'll be on bridge at 02:00 anyway. I'll set the oncall schedule: I'm the secondary for that window. Also @Anya M — thanks, travel safe.

Anya M: Thanks all. Updated rotation in the schedule UI and sent calendar invites. Incident note: customer-facing error rate peaked ~2.2% last 10m, sent initial customer alert to PG team. Leaving logs pinned: https://logs.redwood.example/abc123

PagerBot: Pager acknowledged: Sam R (primary) and Mike L (secondary) assigned for INC-20231125-42. Escalation policy: 15m -> paging secondary -> 30m -> pager to SRE lead.

Sam R: I'll start triage now: checking autoscaler, KV cache hit rate, and model QPS. If needed, we'll enable read-only mode for non-critical endpoints. I'll post updates here.

Mike L: If we need quick rollback, use `deploy rollback inference-runtime-prod --to=2024-11-18-rc1` — tested in staging. Also watch redis-kvcache-1 for CPU spikes.

Anya M: Appreciate it. If things stabilize, cancel page and I'll pick back up after I land. Otherwise, I'll be reachable by SMS.

Sam R: Got it. Leaving bridge notes and will post handoff message at 04:20 UTC before assuming primary. Thanks team.
